# NEW 2026-11-17 theme-rework stage 2: provincial administration and loyalty.
# Generated by gen_theme_admin.py from 《军区详细设计》; edit the generator tables and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

# Theme scope. Sets defaults the first time a theme is seen (new or pre-existing theme).
oe_theme_admin_init = {
    # Stage 3: themes outside the 39 historical regions (Italian, eastern, Austrian, Swiss, old area rule) have no
    # distance band; derive it from the seat's distance to Constantinople, in game units (distance_to is not
    # proportional to map pixels). Readings 2026-11-17: Edirne 99 (band 1), Thessaloniki 143 (band 2),
    # Larissa 160 (band 3). <110 band 1, <170 band 2, <260 band 3, otherwise 4.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance } exists = capital }
        # oe_theme_seat_distance (location scope) = distance_to(location:constantinople); see oe_theme_distance_values.txt
        if = { limit = { capital = { oe_theme_seat_distance < 110 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { capital = { oe_theme_seat_distance < 170 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { capital = { oe_theme_seat_distance < 260 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 3 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 4 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_focus } }
        oe_ta_sync_focus = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_judge value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = oe_theme_loyalty_target_value }
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
    }
}

# Theme scope. Monthly: tenure, loyalty (moves 1 point towards its target), five efficiencies and tiers, officials' pay.
oe_theme_admin_monthly = {
    oe_theme_admin_init = yes
    oe_ta_sync_focus = yes
    # 任期：将军更换时归零
    if = {
        limit = { exists = ruler has_variable = oe_theme_strategos var:oe_theme_strategos = ruler }
        change_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure add = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
    }
    # 忠诚
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_target value = oe_theme_loyalty_target_value }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty < var:oe_theme_loyalty_target } change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty > var:oe_theme_loyalty_target } change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = -1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty >= 70 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty >= 40 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_loyalty >= 20 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 0 } }
    # 军务
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_eff_1 value = oe_theme_eff_value_1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_1 >= 75 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_1 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_1 >= 25 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_tier_1 ?= var:oe_theme_new_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tier_1 value = var:oe_theme_new_tier } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
    # 民政
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_eff_2 value = oe_theme_eff_value_2 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_2 >= 75 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_2 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_2 >= 25 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_tier_2 ?= var:oe_theme_new_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tier_2 value = var:oe_theme_new_tier } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
    # 司法
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_eff_3 value = oe_theme_eff_value_3 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_3 >= 75 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_3 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_3 >= 25 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_tier_3 ?= var:oe_theme_new_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tier_3 value = var:oe_theme_new_tier } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
    # 财政
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_eff_4 value = oe_theme_eff_value_4 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_4 >= 75 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_4 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_4 >= 25 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_tier_4 ?= var:oe_theme_new_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tier_4 value = var:oe_theme_new_tier } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
    # 营建
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_eff_5 value = oe_theme_eff_value_5 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_5 >= 75 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_5 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_eff_5 >= 25 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_new_tier value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_tier_5 ?= var:oe_theme_new_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tier_5 value = var:oe_theme_new_tier } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
    remove_variable = oe_theme_new_tier
    # 属官俸禄与包税
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_theme_official_cost_now value = oe_theme_official_cost }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_judge ?= 1 exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_theme_official_cost_now multiply = -1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_theme_official_cost_now multiply = -1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 2 } add_gold = oe_theme_taxfarm_gain }
    # 档位变化时立即刷新辖区修正，否则每 12 个月刷新一次（新并入的地点也在这时拿到修正）
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_refresh_cd } } }
        oe_theme_admin_apply = yes
        remove_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_refresh_cd months = 12 }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Re-applies tier modifiers on every BYZ location holding one of this theme's buildings.
oe_theme_admin_apply = {
    save_scope_as = oe_theme_admin_owner
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_mil_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_mil_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_mil_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_civ_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_civ_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_civ_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_jus_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_jus_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_jus_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_fin_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_fin_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_fin_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_con_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_con_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_con_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_seat_t0
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_seat_t1
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_seat_t2
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_seat_t3
        remove_location_modifier = oe_theme_taxfarm
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_1 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_mil_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_1 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_mil_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_1 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_mil_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_civ_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_civ_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_civ_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_3 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_jus_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_3 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_jus_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_3 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_jus_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_fin_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_fin_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_4 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_fin_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_5 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_con_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_5 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_con_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_5 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_con_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_taxfarm months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = {
            limit = { this = scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.capital }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_seat_t0 months = 13 mode = replace } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 1 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_seat_t1 months = 13 mode = replace } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 2 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_seat_t2 months = 13 mode = replace } }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_admin_owner.var:oe_theme_tier_2 = 3 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_theme_seat_t3 months = 13 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly: finance units for the BYZ auto modifier.
oe_theme_admin_byz_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fin_units value = oe_theme_fin_units_sum }
    oe_ta_ai_course = yes
}

# Theme scope. var:oe_theme_focus follows the course (the works system picks projects by it).
oe_ta_sync_focus = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ts_course_army = yes } if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus value = 1 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_course_navy = yes } if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus value = 1 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_administrative } if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus value = 2 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian } if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_focus ?= 4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus value = 4 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_focus } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus value = 1 } }
}

# Theme scope. Changes the course: $course$ = army | navy | civil. Callers check oe_ta_can_change_course and
# oe_ta_course_ok_<course> first. Province status (var:oe_theme_status) is not touched.
oe_ta_set_course = {
    oe_ta_course_$course$ = yes
}

oe_ta_course_army = {
    save_scope_as = oe_theme_converted_country
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_conversion_in_progress value = yes }
    capital = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_new_capital }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_conversion_location_trigger = yes }
        add_to_list = oe_theme_conversion_locations
    }
    change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
    oe_ta_remove_course_reforms = yes
    oe_theme_convert_to_ordinary_effect = yes
    oe_ta_course_finish = yes
}
oe_ta_course_navy = {
    save_scope_as = oe_theme_converted_country
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_conversion_in_progress value = yes }
    capital = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_new_capital }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_conversion_location_trigger = yes }
        add_to_list = oe_theme_conversion_locations
    }
    change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme_naval
    oe_ta_remove_course_reforms = yes
    oe_theme_convert_to_naval_effect = yes
    oe_ta_course_finish = yes
}
oe_ta_course_civil = {
    save_scope_as = oe_theme_converted_country
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_conversion_in_progress value = yes }
    capital = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_new_capital }
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_conversion_location_trigger = yes }
        add_to_list = oe_theme_conversion_locations
    }
    change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme_administrative
    oe_ta_remove_course_reforms = yes
    oe_theme_convert_to_administrative_effect = yes
    oe_ta_course_finish = yes
}
# Theme scope (= scope:oe_theme_converted_country).
oe_ta_remove_course_reforms = {
    if = { limit = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_system_subject } remove_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
    if = { limit = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_naval_subject } remove_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_naval_subject }
    if = { limit = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_administrative_subject } remove_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_administrative_subject }
    if = { limit = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_frontier_subject } remove_reform = government_reform:oe_byz_theme_frontier_subject }
}
oe_ta_course_finish = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            save_scope_as = oe_pillars_org
            if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_theme_converted_country = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = prev } } }
                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_theme_converted_country
            }
        }
        scope:oe_theme_converted_country = { oe_pillars_classify_member_effect = yes }
    }
    scope:oe_theme_converted_country = {
        remove_variable = oe_theme_conversion_in_progress
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
        oe_ta_sync_focus = yes
        oe_theme_refresh_name = yes
        ruler ?= { reset_ruler_title = {} }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. AI Byzantium changes at most one theme's course a year, keeping 20 authority in reserve.
oe_ta_ai_course = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ta_ai_cd }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 25 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ta_ai_cd months = 12 }
        random_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ta_ai_wants_change = yes }
            save_scope_as = oe_ta_ai_pick
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_ta_ai_pick }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
            scope:oe_ta_ai_pick = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus_cd years = 5 }
                if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_army = yes } oe_ta_set_course = { course = army } }
                else_if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_navy = yes } oe_ta_set_course = { course = navy } }
                else = { oe_ta_set_course = { course = civil } }
            }
        }
    }
}
